doc: Europe/Berlin springs forward on 29 March: the local day is 23 hours, 28 March 23:00Z to 29 March 22:00Z
Europe/Berlin falls back on 26 October 2025: the local day is 25 hours, 25 October 22:00Z to 26 October 23:00Z
100 W held from 22:50Z and 200 W from 23:10Z straddle Berlin's winter midnight (23:00Z); counters rise across it
the production counter restarts from 5004 to 2 inside the 12:00Z hour and keeps rising from there
readings cover only 09:20Z to 14:40Z of the local day, 20 minutes apart; the first bucket has no predecessor
zero power overnight, negative grid power while exporting, counters standing still for hours
no readings from 05:00Z to 09:00Z, longer than the 3 hours an hourly counter delta may bridge
the last reading of the evening (19:30Z, 250 W) is the only one until 05:15Z the next morning, past Berlin's midnight at 22:00Z
a production.today register falls to 0 at Berlin's midnight (22:00Z in summer); its lifetime twin keeps rising
three days across New Year in Berlin (31 December 23:00Z): months and years split inside the window
one import sample reads 99.9 between readings of 250: the figure falls with it and the next bucket books the rise back
